caption:
Name files so they sort themselves. 📁

Use: 2026-11-27_invoice_acme.pdf

Date first (year-month-day), then what it is, then who. No spaces, use underscores.

scenes.text: Why does finding one file take five minutes?
scenes.sub: Fix it with one naming rule.
scenes.say: Why does finding one file take five minutes? Fix it with one naming rule.
Instead of final final version two, name it with the date, what it is, and who it's for.

scenes.title: The naming rule
items: Then who or what it's for
scenes.say: Three parts. Date first, year, month, day. Then what the file is. Then who or what it's for.

scenes.title: Year first sorts by date
scenes.body: Files line up in order with no extra effort.
scenes.say: Why it works. Putting the year first makes your files line up in date order on their own.
